meta.homeTitle: Droblet — Your wardrobe now thinks for you
meta.homeDescription: Photograph your clothes; Droblet prepares your outfit for every day and every trip. Personal wardrobe, style assistant and smart suitcase.

hero.title: No more "what do I wear" mornings or hours of packing.
hero.body: Your wardrobe now thinks for you. Photograph your clothes; Droblet prepares your outfit for every day and every trip.
hero.platforms: iOS and Android · Turkish and English

how.title: A ready wardrobe in three steps.

steps.title: Digitise
steps.body: Photograph your clothes or pick from the ready-made library. Droblet recognises the type, colour and fabric, and organises your wardrobe by category and season.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Daily and weekly looks are prepared around the season, the weather, your calendar and your colour palette.

steps.title: Complete
steps.body: If a look is missing a piece, we suggest one in your size and budget; one tap takes you to the brand's store.

features.title: Shortens every morning and every trip.

items.title: Style advisor
items.body: The outfit of the day is ready every morning: matched to the weather and the occasion in your calendar, from your own wardrobe.

items.title: See it on me
items.body: See outfits and store products on your own photo. AI images are always shown with the "On you" label.

items.title: Smart suitcase
items.body: Enter the city and dates; you get daily looks and a packing list where every piece is worn more than once.

items.title: Colour palette
items.body: Finds your season type and the tones that suit you best from a face photo, and shows how well your wardrobe matches your palette.

items.title: Style store
items.body: Find the pieces that complete your look in your size. Payment and delivery happen in the brand's own store.

items.title: Friends
items.body: Rate your friends' looks with 1–5 stars, get ratings on your own looks, and browse wardrobes.

legal.draftBody: This page is a draft of structure and headings; it is not a binding text. The final text will be published after legal review.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Droblet Terms of Use — draft, pending legal review.
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Droblet mobile app and this website. The service is provided by Droblet Ltd (London, United Kingdom).

sections.heading: Scope of the service
paragraphs: Droblet is a personal wardrobe app where you digitise your clothes, get outfit suggestions and plan your suitcase for trips.
Draft — pending legal review: the full definition and limits of the service.

sections.heading: Account
paragraphs: You create an account to use the app. You can delete your account at any time from the app (Profile › Settings › Delete my account) or from the Delete my account page on this site.
Draft — pending legal review: age requirement, account security and user obligations.

sections.heading: Your content and photos
paragraphs: Your photos and the images generated on you are visible only to you. You can delete them at any time from Profile › Privacy.
Draft — pending legal review: content licence, prohibited uses and the reporting process.

sections.heading: AI-generated content
paragraphs: Outfit suggestions and images labelled "On you" are generated by artificial intelligence and are meant to give you an idea.
Draft — pending legal review: limits of liability for AI output.

sections.heading: Store and third-party brands
paragraphs: Droblet does not take payment. When you want to buy a product you are taken to the brand's own store; payment and delivery are completed there.
Draft — pending legal review: liability for third-party stores and commission disclosure.

sections.heading: Membership
paragraphs: The terms of Droblet Membership are set out on the Subscription Terms page.
Draft — pending legal review.

sections.heading: Liability, changes and governing law
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: limitation of liability, notice of changes to these terms, governing law and jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: contact address and channels.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Droblet Privacy Policy — draft, pending legal review.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Droblet processes personal data. The data controller is Droblet Ltd (London, United Kingdom). For users in Türkiye the KVKK applies, alongside the UK GDPR.

sections.heading: Our core privacy promises
paragraphs: Your photos and the images generated on you are visible only to you.
Your face and full-length photos are never shown to anyone else, under any visibility setting.
You can delete your photos and generated images at any time from Profile › Privacy; this works without deleting your account.
You choose who sees your wardrobe: everyone, followers only, or private.

sections.heading: Data we process
paragraphs: Your account details (such as your e-mail address), the pieces you add to your wardrobe and their photos, your full-length and face photos, the looks you create, and your calendar and suitcase plans.
Draft — pending legal review: the full list of data categories and the legal basis for each.

sections.heading: What we use data for
paragraphs: To organise your wardrobe, prepare outfit and suitcase suggestions, run the colour palette analysis and generate "On you" images.
Draft — pending legal review: purposes of processing and legal bases.

sections.heading: Processing with artificial intelligence
paragraphs: "On you" images and the colour palette analysis are generated by artificial intelligence from the photos you upload.
Draft — pending legal review: service providers, international transfers and the scope of explicit consent.

sections.heading: Sharing and transfers
paragraphs: When you go to a brand's store to buy a product, payment and delivery are completed there; Droblet does not receive payment details.
Draft — pending legal review: processors, recipient groups and safeguards for international transfers.

sections.heading: Retention and deletion
paragraphs: You can delete your photos and generated images from Profile › Privacy, and your whole account from the app or from the Delete my account page on this site.
Draft — pending legal review: retention periods.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: your rights under KVKK Article 11 and the UK GDPR, and how to exercise them.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: data controller contact details and request channels.

kvkk.title: KVKK Privacy Notice
kvkk.description: Droblet KVKK Privacy Notice — draft, pending legal review.
kvkk.intro: This is a draft of the privacy notice prepared under Article 10 of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law no. 6698 (KVKK). The Turkish version of this notice is the original.

sections.heading: Data controller
paragraphs: Droblet Ltd (London, United Kingdom).
Draft — pending legal review: registration and address details, and the representative in Türkiye if any.

sections.heading: Personal data processed
paragraphs: Identity and contact data (such as your e-mail address), visual data (photos of pieces, full-length and face photo, images generated on you), and usage data (wardrobe, look, calendar and suitcase records).
Draft — pending legal review: the data category and scope of the face photo and colour palette analysis.

sections.heading: Purposes of processing
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: purposes of processing for each data category.

sections.heading: Legal bases and method of collection
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: legal bases under KVKK Articles 5 and 6; data is collected electronically through the app.

sections.heading: Explicit consent
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: the explicit consent text for processing the full-length and face photo, the colour palette analysis and international transfers, and how consent is withdrawn.

sections.heading: Transfers
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: the recipient groups data is transferred to and the basis for international transfers.

sections.heading: Your rights under KVKK Article 11
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: the list of rights and how to apply.

subscriptionTerms.title: Subscription Terms
subscriptionTerms.description: Droblet Membership subscription terms — draft, pending legal review.
subscriptionTerms.intro: This page summarises the terms of the Droblet Membership subscription.

sections.heading: What Droblet Membership includes
paragraphs: 30 AI images a month, the personal style advisor, the smart suitcase and the colour palette analysis.
Wardrobe, looks, calendar, store and friends are open without a membership too.

sections.heading: AI image allowance
paragraphs: Membership includes 30 AI images a month. The allowance renews every month; unused images do not carry over to the next month.
If you need more, you can buy an extra AI image pack in the app.

sections.heading: Price and free trial
paragraphs: Membership is monthly or yearly. The current price and trial length are shown on the App Store and Google Play.
Draft — pending legal review: charging at the end of the trial, and taxes.

sections.heading: Renewal and cancellation
paragraphs: Your membership is managed through the App Store / Google Play and is cancelled there. Deleting your account does not cancel the subscription; cancel it in your store settings first.
Draft — pending legal review: auto-renewal terms.

sections.heading: Refunds and right of withdrawal
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: refund conditions and the right of withdrawal.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: notice of changes to price and scope.

cookies.title: Cookie Notice
cookies.description: Droblet Cookie Notice — draft, pending legal review.
cookies.intro: This notice explains the use of cookies and similar technologies on this website.

sections.heading: Cookies on this site
paragraphs: This site's own code does not set cookies, does not save data to browser storage, and contains no analytics or advertising tools.
Draft — pending legal review: the list of strictly necessary cookies the infrastructure provider may use for security.

sections.heading: Types of cookies
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review: definitions of strictly necessary, functional, analytics and marketing cookies and their status on this site.

sections.heading: Managing your preferences
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings.
Draft — pending legal review: preference management if a cookie that requires consent is added.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: Draft — pending legal review.
